A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DC-AE research. Their complete text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices are readable, and retained content can be matched across relocation and renumbering.

before.justification: v1 reports original reconstruction and image-generation experiments, efficiency measurements, component ablations, and qualitative samples.

after.justification: v3 retains original empirical results and adds baseline comparisons, larger-model experiments, and larger-batch results in the main text and Appendix C.

M1.justification: Residual autoencoding, the three-phase high-resolution adaptation procedure, losses, and DC-AE architecture remain unchanged. The added UViT-2B configuration extends the evaluated diffusion-model sizes without changing the proposed autoencoder method.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same ImageNet, SAM, FFHQ, MJHQ, and MapillaryVistas data coverage and reconstruction, conditional/unconditional generation, and text-to-image tasks. The existing 1024- and 2048-resolution generation experiments move to Appendix C; they are not newly introduced coverage.

E2.justification: Table 3 adds SD3-VAE, SDXL-VAE, and Asym-VAE comparisons for UViT-S, and adds Flux-VAE and Asym-VAE for DiT-XL and UViT-H. The FFHQ/MJHQ comparison, formerly Table 4 and now Table 5, adds SD3-VAE, Flux-VAE, SDXL-VAE, and Asym-VAE. This substantially broadens the evaluated comparator set.

E3.justification: v3 extends the existing evaluation with a 1.6-billion-parameter UViT-2B configuration and explicitly marked batch-size-1024 runs, versus the standard 256, for DiT-XL on ImageNet and DiT-S on FFHQ/MJHQ. It removes the DiT-XL 256-token patch/compression sweep from Table 1. Existing splits, metrics, and efficiency-profiling procedures remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The existing model-size analysis extends to UViT-2B, with Figure 9 displaying the scaling relationship, and new rows examine larger-batch training. Conversely, Table 1 loses the DiT-XL patch/compression ablation while retaining the UViT-S sweep. Residual-autoencoding, resolution-adaptation, and GAN-refinement analyses remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental seed counts, repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The added batch-size settings do not constitute statistical replication or uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: Tables 3 and 5 substantially expand the reported results while retaining matched existing values. New UViT-2B results give unguided FID 7.78 for DC-AE-f64 versus 9.73 for SD-VAE-f8. The new larger-batch DiT-XL/DC-AE-f32 row reports guided FID 2.41 alongside the retained standard-batch 2.84; FFHQ similarly adds 11.39 alongside 13.65. These are additional configurations, not same-setting score revisions. Table 1 removes three DiT-XL result rows.

T1.justification: The space-to-channel transformation and residual-shortcut equations are unchanged, and neither version contains formal theorems or proofs. Adding the Shi et al. citation does not alter the mathematical content.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: residual autoencoding, decoupled high-resolution adaptation, compression ratios up to 128, and faster diffusion models without sacrificing quality. The headline UViT-H speedups and FID comparison are unchanged.

C2.justification: Although Section 3.3 loses a repeated explanation about separating token compression from denoising, that interpretation remains in the introduction and Figure 2 caption. The explanation linking larger latent channels to greater required model capacity also remains. Figure 9 supports the existing scaling interpretation without adding a distinct mechanism or limitation.

D1.justification: New Appendix B specifies UViT-2B as 1.6 billion parameters, depth 28, hidden dimension 2048, and 32 attention heads. Table captions identify the new fourfold-batch settings. Existing implementation descriptions, hardware and profiling information, and the code-access link remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v3 adds Zhu et al. on asymmetric VQGAN, Podell et al. on SDXL, and Shi et al. for the space-to-channel operation. Related work briefly discusses heavier decoders and task-specific priors, while retaining the original novelty and research-positioning claims.

P1.justification: Most prose and the main section structure are retained. Changes include a short related-work addition, trimming repeated explanation in Section 3.3, adding Appendix B, and relocating the high-resolution generation discussion to Appendix C.

P2.justification: v3 adds the model-scaling Figure 9, expands Table 3, and shortens Table 1. The high-resolution table moves to the appendix and expands as Table 5; the retained text-to-image table becomes Table 4. Existing method diagrams and qualitative image panels are preserved, with localized resizing, reflow, and renumbering.

improvement.justification: The broader VAE comparisons and added UViT-2B results strengthen empirical support across alternative autoencoders and model sizes, while Appendix B documents the new configuration. These gains mainly corroborate the existing findings. Removing the DiT-XL patch/compression ablation reduces supporting evidence for that argument, but the retained UViT-S ablation and expanded comparisons support a modest net improvement.
